    Product description

    ⚠️ IMPORTANT: READ BEFORE REDEEMING ⚠️

    This is a     USD Currency Razer Gold Gift Card. It can ONLY be redeemed on a Razer Gold account where the wallet region is set to the United States (USD).

    🚨 CRITICAL WARNING: If you attempt to redeem this code on an INR wallet (or any other non-USD currency), the system will reject it and display an "Invalid Code" error.

    How to Create a USD Razer Gold Wallet:
    If you do not have a USD wallet, please follow these exact steps to create one before trying to redeem your code:

    1. Go to gold.razer.com and click Create Account.
    2. Enter your details and verify your email address.
    3. Log in, click your profile icon, and follow the prompts to complete your profile setup.
    4. When asked to select your location/region, you     MUST choose United States. This will permanently lock your wallet currency to USD.
